provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: The 600.0 s per output frame assumed in the time label (L116) is not derivable from this file; it must match PLOT_INTV in the case input, which is not readable here.
audit_member_text: Displayed time hard-codes 600 seconds per file number at L116; no file metadata or parameter in this script establishes that output cadence.

base_member_text: bubble and foam are explicitly 'made up' for visualization (comment L81): thresholds 10 s, 600 s, decay scales 10 and 50, amplitudes 1.5 and 1.0, floor 0.1, and sentinel 9000.0 (L84-L97) have no stated physical basis in the file.
Registration offsets +105 and +220 and image rotation imrotate(RGB,1) (L25-L26, L106) are 'approximately' matched per comment L24; the geo-accuracy is unquantified.
The 'age' output field is read as wave/breaker age in seconds (L73, L85, L93); its exact model definition is not in this file.
mov(k).cdata accumulates all 158 frames in memory though each is written immediately (L136-L138); the array is never reused.
foam has no NaN floor analogous to bubble(bubble<0.1)=NaN, so the foam pcolor layer covers the whole wet domain with near-zero values over the background image (L95-L97, L124).

audit_member_text: Mask-application inconsistency: mask is read at L63-L69 and applied to age/foam and eta at L94 and L100, but bubble is derived from the unmasked breaker/age field at L84-L90 and plotted at L110. Positive age values in inactive cells can therefore render bubbles over masked land/dry cells.

Every binary fopen/fread sequence (L12-L15, L54-L57, L63-L66, L71-L74) assumes exactly m*n single-precision values and never checks fileID or the count returned by fread. A missing or short file propagates into transpose/flip and then conflicts with the fixed 800-by-660 X/Y grids at L109-L124.
